items.title: Wayne Bergeron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2020
items.q: You know such-and-such sounds like Plas you know, or we’ll get Pete Christlieb or whatever you know.

ctx.x: Would someone like Henry Mancini say I’m not doing this recording unless I get these four particular players? Would they hold the thing up until a time where all those people are available?

If he wanted that, of course they would. I mean most of the time they’ve got alternates. They go, oh man, Plas Johnson can’t do this one, you know, but we have to do this today. Who’s your next choice? Who do you like? You know such-and-such sounds like Plas you know, or we’ll get Pete Christlieb or whatever you know. So they probably do that. But there’s been times even in my thing where they’ve said — where I couldn’t be there and they’re writing for me and they’ve rescheduled the thing. That’s a kind of a good…
